newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA BAT FIRST AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA BAT FIRST AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA.

text.p: India won the toss and chose to bat in their one day international match against South Africa in Port Elizabeth on Sunday.
South Africa - Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Lance Klusener, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Jacques Kallis, Hansie Cronje (captain), Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Allan Donald, Paul Adams.
India - Rahul Dravid, Saurav Ganguly, Javagal Srinath, Sachin Tendulkar, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Anil Kumble, Saba Karim, Salil Ankola, Robin Singh, Venkatesh Prasad.
